property_summary: For any admissible deposit amount, calling withdrawAll through an attacker that re-enters once must succeed (the re-entrant call sees zeroed credit because state is updated before the external call); the mutant performs the external call first, so the re-entrant withdrawal double-deducts and underflows balance, reverting.
change_summary: Move the external call 'msg.sender.call{value: oCredit}("")' before the state updates, enabling reentrancy that observes stale credit/balance.
